618-1916-2921.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Changeling Titan.
When the Changeling Titan token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Changeling Titan token.
When the Changeling Titan token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2403-4279-6112--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2403-4279-6112--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake, Fumulus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Fumulus ability, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2113-4687-5479.notablePrerequisites: Lost Jitte has at least three counters on it.
2113-4687-5479.description:
Activate Karametra's Favor by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Lost Jitte.
Activate Lost Jitte two times by removing three charge counters from it, untapping two lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding {1}{G/U}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Lost Jitte, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

1496-1981-2034-2415.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1496-1981-2034-2415.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

5662-6797--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
5662-6797--5--195.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Reyhan trigger.
Resolve Reyhan's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1409-3099-6006-7296.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

2438-7084-7705.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Mole Man triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2034-4986-6635--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Ambrosia Whiteheart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Ambrosia Whiteheart enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ambrosia Whiteheart
Repeat.
2034-4986-6635--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

650-891-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

240-1753-5147-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature except Terra

6575-6685-7297.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Mesmerizing Dose.
When the Mesmerizing Dose token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Repeat from step 2 two additional times, from Esper Terra's second and third chapter abilities triggering.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1010-1477-6972.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Arcbound Prototype.
When Arcbound Prototype dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Prototype's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Prototype from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

1170-1329-1482-3464.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Jeweled Lotus.
Cast Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Hyrax Tower Scout.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

141-2292-6928.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2292-6928.description:
Cast Prison Break either from your hand by paying {4}{B} or from your graveyard for its mayhem cost by paying {3}{B}, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Prison Break.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Prison Break, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Prison Break copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-2292-6928.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if Prison Break is in your graveyard.

277-1409-2653-6839.description:
Activate Ignis by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Ignis enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Ignis.
Resolve the Ignis trigger, causing you to look at the top six cards of your library and put a land card from among them onto the battlefield.
If you put a land onto the battlefield this way, Nissa and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {U}.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the land that entered
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat.
277-1409-2653-6839.notes: This combo can fail if Ignis does not reveal a land. You can use additional mana to restart the combo if desired should this happen. The combo also assumes every land you grab will be mana-producing.

2457-4068-4289-4365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2457-4068-4289-4365.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

333-2730-5256.notablePrerequisites: Kaya's Ghostform attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-2730-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Shepherd of the Cosmos' power.
Repeat.

1061-5131-5935.notablePrerequisites:
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
You have the city's blessing.
Cynical Loner does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent, or you have another way to tap Cynical Loner each turn.
1061-5131-5935.description:
Activate Timstream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Declare Cynical Loner as an attacker, or tap Cynical Loner by any other method.
At the beginning of your second main phase, Cynical Loner triggers, causing you to search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it into your graveyard.
Cast Timestream Navigator from your graveyard by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

185-3617-4293.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mystic Retrieval by paying {3}{U}, returning Runic Repetition to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Mystic Retrieval from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {2}{R}, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand and exiling Mystic Retrieval.
Cast Runic Repetition by paying {2}{U}, returning Mystic Retrieval from exile to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1597-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Gyre Sage does not have summoning sickness, and has at least four +1/+1 counters on it.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Gyre Sage
1597-5200.description:
Activate Gyre Sage by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Gyre Sage
Repeat.
1597-5200.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, you may equip Sword of the Paruns to any creature you control and untap them infinite times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

628-3967-5405.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Soulstinger.
When Soulstinger dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Soulstinger enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.

2021-2289-3038.notablePrerequisites: Sovereign Okinec Ahau does not have summoning sickness.
2021-2289-3038.description:
Declare Sovereign Okinec Ahau as an attacker.
Sovereign Okinec Ahau triggers, putting twenty +1/+1 counters on the creature that has Colossification attached.
Simic Ascendancy's first ability triggers, putting 20 growth counters on it.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy's second ability triggers, causing you to win the game.

277-435-1227-4679.notablePrerequisites: Yenna does not have summoning sickness.
277-435-1227-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Ordeal of Nylea, then untapping Yenna and causing you to scry 2.
Activate Auratog by sacrificing the Ordeal of Nylea token.
The Ordeal of Nylea token's second ability triggers, causing you to search your library for two basic land cards and put them onto the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers twice, untapping them.
Resolve the Auratog ability from step 2, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate the two lands by tapping them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

703-2232-2972-3809-5184.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it, Ganax and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger, creating two copies of any noncreature nonartifact permanent that are 3/3 Dragons.
When the Dragons enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and Ganax each trigger twice.
Resolve the first Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Astral Dragon from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve all Ganax triggers, creating six Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

353-2034-4720.manaNeeded: {2}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
353-2034-4720.notablePrerequisites: Your storm count is equal to or higher than five plus the number of times you've cast Aeve from the command zone this game.
353-2034-4720.description:
Cast Aeve from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{G}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Aeve's storm ability triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of itself for each spell you've cast previously this turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing the nontoken Aeve and two Aeve tokens, adding six {C}.
Choose to have Aeve returned to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Stonework Packbeast three times by paying {6}, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Aeve token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Aeve.
Repeat from step 1.

141-554-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-554-4050.description:
Cast Extract from Darkness by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Extract from Darkness.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Extract from Darkness
Resolve the Extract from Darkness copy, causing each player to mill two cards and returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3525-3590-4050-4395.notablePrerequisites: Pemmin's Aura and Lightning Prowess attached to Warchanter Skald.
3525-3590-4050-4395.description:
Activate Warchanter Skald by tapping it.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker creature token.
Resolve the Warchanter Skald ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Dwarf Berserker, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Warchanter Skald.
Repeat.

122-1545-1734-2034.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability and Trostani.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Fiend Hunter's toughness.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Phyrexian Delver until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Fiend Hunter, adding {C}{C}.
Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Phyrexian Delver from exile to the battlefield.
Phyrexian Delver enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Trostani.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Phyrexian Delver's toughness.
Resolve the Phyrexian Delver trigger, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose three life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization
